ordinal_robustness.polychoric_feasibility: ordinal correlation matrix conditioning: min eigenvalue -0.000, condition number 13378043871.7; a full 40x40 polychoric matrix is not reliably estimable at n approx p, so rank/Kendall correlation-matrix PCA is used instead
ordinal_robustness.interpretation: PCA on the Spearman and Kendall ordinal correlation matrices reproduces the Pearson reference partition exactly (ARI = 1.0), so the four-profile structure is not an artefact of treating the nine-point Likert responses as interval-scaled. A more aggressive rank-transform-then-PCA variant agrees only moderately (ARI = 0.49), with the disagreement concentrated in the two small clusters, consistent with their acknowledged fragility.

respondent_quality.caveat: Full-scale alpha is inflated by the multidimensional item pool and by duplicated response vectors; it is reported for completeness, not as a unidimensionality claim.
